$comment: Shared sample-screen manifest for the skills family (shots tool). One source for page names, demo skills, templates, conversations, per-page presets, theme seeds and the clock across the iOS, Android debug and Web dev shot entries. Every end builds in-memory skills / conversations from this file through its production models and never writes a real store, signs in or touches the network (AI draft and fork are not exercised). Skill fields follow the Server Skill DTO; omitted fields take the decoder defaults. Keys starting with '$' are documentation and ignored by readers.
$themeSeed: null = the app's default palette; otherwise a custom seed colour run through each end's production theme derivation (the same path the theme settings page uses). Pages ending in Amber / Teal are the theme-tier check from the acceptance list.

$states: Inputs for the page state variants (page field state). draftDescription = what the user typed in the Skills page describe box, shown in the draft flow while generating. needWhen = a new skill's form with auto-invoke on and an empty when-to-use. trialFailedMessages = the try-it session after one failed request; state = "failed" with error = "rate_limited" is an assistant reply the provider rejected with HTTP 429, shown through each end's production chat failure mapping (no retry happens).

$pages: subject: home = home screen (iOS / Android only), mine / templates = Skills page segments, detail / edit = the first skill, composer = the conversation with the picker open on query 'we' and one chip, used = the conversation with the reply's used chip expanded, homePicker = home with the picker open on query 'we' and the same one chip as composer (iOS / Android only), improvePrompt = the improve conversation with the improve prompt under the reply, improveDiff = the same with the diff panel open, trial = the try-it session page, usage = the usage page with the skill manifest row, tokenCost = the first conversation with the token-usage dialog of its reply open, emptyReply = the empty-reply conversation. Optional page fields: data = "empty" seeds no user skills and no notes (first-run state; templates and conversations unchanged); autoInvoke = false turns the global auto-invoke switch off (home subtitle falls back to the slash hint, E-45). Both default to the full manifest with auto-invoke on. Optional page field state refines the subject (unknown values refuse the page like data): mine + draftGenerating = the Skills page with the draft flow open on its generating step for states.draftDescription (the request never finishes); edit + draftFailed = the editor for a new skill after the draft request failed with nothing parsed, with the draft-failed banner (each end's production failure path hands the editor the parsed partial draft, here empty; the description is not carried); edit + needWhen = the editor for a new skill from states.needWhen with auto-invoke on and when-to-use empty, showing the needs-when error as it appears on that end (after a save attempt where the end shows it only then); composer + full = composer with the conversation's skills replaced by the first three user skills (each end's current picker header); trial + empty = the trial page before any message (saved instructions, no Save to skill button); trial + failed = the trial page with states.trialFailedMessages and saved instructions. templates + state loading = Templates segment with no catalog cache and the catalog fetch still in flight (never resolves): three skeleton blocks, no text; templates + state failed = no catalog cache and the fetch failed: skeleton gone, one line of secondary text plus a Retry text button.
